Der Läufer im Flur ist rot.

The spoon lies next to the fork.

Wait a moment!

Synonyms (3): der Instrumentalist (instrumentalist), der Künstler (artist), der Spieler (player)

The musician plays the guitar.

The musicians rehearse every day.

My brother is a musician.
Notes: Feminine: die Musikerin. Musik + -er. Related: die Musik, musizieren (to make music).

On Sunday evening a music film is on.

Synonyms (3): die Bezeichnung (designation), der Titel (title), der Rufname (name one is called)

What is your name?

My name is Anna.

Under what name is the table reserved?

Synonyms (3): der Gliedsatz (subordinate clause), der Teilsatz (clause), der abhängige Satz (dependent clause)
Antonyms (3): der Hauptsatz (main clause), der Satz (sentence), ~der Aussagesatz (statement)
Example 1:
Nach weil steht ein Nebensatz.
After weil comes a subordinate clause.
Example 2:
Im Nebensatz steht das Verb am Ende.
In the subordinate clause the verb is at the end.
Example 3:
Ich bleibe zu Hause, weil ich müde bin.
I stay at home because I am tired.
Notes: Grammar term. Neben- (secondary) + Satz. Introduced by weil, dass, ob, wenn, obwohl. Separated from the Hauptsatz by a comma.

Synonyms (3): die Stelle (spot), der Platz (place), die Ortschaft (village, locality)

The place is beautiful.

We live in a small town.

Place and date are at the top of the letter.

The nurse takes care of the patients.

The carers work in shifts.

He is a carer in a care home.

Synonyms (3): der Entwurf (draft), das Vorhaben (project), der Zeitplan (timetable)

Wir machen einen Plan.
We make a plan.

Hast du schon Pläne für das Wochenende?
Do you already have plans for the weekend?

Der Plan hängt an der Wand.
The schedule hangs on the wall.
Notes: Compounds: Putzplan (cleaning schedule), Stadtplan (city map), Fahrplan (timetable). Verb: planen (to plan). The plural has an umlaut: Pläne.

Synonyms (3): die Mehrzahl (plural), der Pluralis (Latin term), ~die Mehrheit (majority)

What is the plural of Kiste?

The plural of Kind is Kinder.

Synonyms (3): der Reinigungsplan (cleaning plan), der Haushaltsplan (household plan), der Wochenplan (weekly plan)

The cleaning schedule hangs in the kitchen.

According to the cleaning schedule it is my turn this week.

In our shared flat there is a cleaning schedule.

Synonyms (3): der Niederschlag (precipitation), der Schauer (shower), der Guss (downpour)

The rain is cold today.

When it rains we stay at home.

Der Regen hört bald auf.
The rain will stop soon.
Notes: Verb: regnen (es regnet). Adjective: regnerisch (rainy). Compounds: Regenschirm, Regenmantel, Regenwetter. im Regen = in the rain.

Synonyms (3): der Schirm (umbrella), der Knirps (folding umbrella), der Sonnenschirm (~ parasol)

Take an umbrella with you!

Notes: Regen + Schirm. Short: der Schirm. Verbs: aufspannen (to open up), mitnehmen (to take along).

The actor plays the inspector.

Where is the key for the flat?

In the end he says thank you.

Schluss für heute!
That is it for today!

Zum Schluss möchte ich noch etwas sagen.
Finally I would like to say something.
Notes: am Schluss / zum Schluss = in the end / finally. Schluss machen = to break up. Verb: schließen (schloss · hat geschlossen). Not the same as der Schlüssel (key).

Synonyms (3): der Arbeitstisch (work table), das Pult (desk, lectern), der Bürotisch (office table)

The desk stands by the window.

Auf meinem Schreibtisch liegt viel Papier.
A lot of paper lies on my desk.

Ich sitze den ganzen Tag am Schreibtisch.
I sit at the desk all day.
Notes: schreiben + Tisch; the article comes from the last word (der Tisch). Place: am Schreibtisch (Dativ, Wo?).

On Sunday evenings a crime film is often on.

The sports field lies behind the school.

Who was the perpetrator?

Der Wechsel von Sommer zu Herbst ist schön.
The change from summer to autumn is nice.

Notes: Verb: wechseln (to change). Wechselpräposition = two-way preposition (Dativ or Akkusativ). Compounds: Jobwechsel, Wechselgeld (change), Wechselkurs (exchange rate).

That is pointless.

For what purpose do you need that?
